principle_cards.principle_text: Theft requires dishonest appropriation of property belonging to another with intention permanently to deprive.
principle_cards.exact_quote: A person commits theft if he dishonestly appropriates property belonging to another with the intention of permanently depriving the other of it
principle_cards.scope: Starting point for all theft/shoplifting liability analysis.
principle_cards.limits: Does not itself resolve dishonesty, appropriation, belonging-to-another, or intention permanently to deprive.

principle_cards.principle_text: The statutory dishonesty analysis includes belief-based exclusions and warns that willingness to pay does not automatically prevent dishonesty.
principle_cards.exact_quote: A person’s appropriation of property belonging to another may be dishonest notwithstanding that he is willing to pay for the property.
principle_cards.scope: Important for forgotten-payment and later-offer-to-pay shop incidents.
principle_cards.limits: Must be read with HK dishonesty authorities and the user’s actual belief at the time.

principle_cards.principle_text: Appropriation is an assumption of the rights of an owner, including later keeping or dealing as owner.
principle_cards.exact_quote: Any assumption by a person of the rights of an owner amounts to an appropriation
principle_cards.scope: Maps the actus reus in shop/store taking cases.
principle_cards.limits: Appropriation alone is not theft without the mental elements.

principle_cards.principle_text: Property belongs to another if another person has possession or control of it or a proprietary right or interest.
principle_cards.exact_quote: Property shall be regarded as belonging to any person having possession or control of it
principle_cards.scope: Usually straightforward for unpaid store goods but still needs item/control evidence.
principle_cards.limits: Does not prove appropriation or mens rea.

principle_cards.principle_text: Intention permanently to deprive includes treating the thing as one’s own to dispose of regardless of the other’s rights.
principle_cards.exact_quote: if his intention is to treat the thing as his own to dispose of regardless of the other’s rights
principle_cards.scope: Central to forgotten-payment disputes and later retention.
principle_cards.limits: Needs evidence of the accused’s intention at the relevant time.

principle_cards.principle_text: Dishonesty is treated as a state-of-mind issue in the cited CFA discussion.
principle_cards.exact_quote: Dishonesty addresses a wholly different matter
principle_cards.scope: Research support for the dishonesty component, not a shoplifting-specific holding.
principle_cards.limits: The case concerns fraud/forgery substitution, not a convenience-store theft; human review needed before answer-safe promotion.

principle_cards.principle_text: Chan Kam Ching records the Ghosh test as the Hong Kong position at that time.
principle_cards.exact_quote: the Ghosh test for dishonesty represents the law in Hong Kong at present
principle_cards.scope: Candidate dishonesty-test authority for HK criminal dishonesty issues.
principle_cards.limits: Do not state that Ivey has or has not replaced Ghosh in Hong Kong without a current verified HK treatment card.

principle_cards.principle_text: The probate analysis must identify whether the deceased died intestate as to a beneficial interest and what counts as the residuary estate after proper expenses and liabilities.
principle_cards.exact_quote: intestate includes a person who leaves a will but dies intestate as to some beneficial interest in his estate
principle_cards.scope: Frames no-will/partial-intestacy and net estate questions.
principle_cards.limits: Does not choose the distribution class; use Cap. 73 ss.4-5 after this gate.

principle_cards.principle_text: A spouse gate requires checking whether any surviving husband or wife was in a valid marriage for Cap. 73 purposes.
principle_cards.exact_quote: valid marriage means a marriage celebrated or contracted in accordance with the Marriage Ordinance
principle_cards.scope: Controls whether spouse-entitlement branches must be analysed before issue-only distribution.
principle_cards.limits: Foreign marriage facts may require proof of the law and validity of the place of celebration.

principle_cards.principle_text: If the intestate leaves issue but no husband or wife, the residuary estate is held on statutory trusts for the issue.
principle_cards.exact_quote: If the intestate leaves issue but no husband or wife the residuary estate of the intestate shall be held on the statutory trusts for the issue of the intestate.
principle_cards.scope: Core distribution branch for the user’s no-spouse assumption.
principle_cards.limits: If a surviving spouse exists, the s.4 spouse branches must be applied first.

principle_cards.principle_text: Children living at death take at the child level; issue of a predeceased child take that child’s share by stocks, and issue do not take if their parent is living and capable of taking.
principle_cards.exact_quote: no issue shall take whose parent is living at the death of the intestate and is so capable of taking
principle_cards.limits: Requires knowing whether the granddaughters’ parent predeceased and was capable of taking.

principle_cards.principle_text: The personal representative holds the intestate residuary estate as trustee for those beneficially entitled, subject to administration powers.
principle_cards.exact_quote: the personal representative of any person dying intestate shall be a trustee for the persons beneficially entitled under this Ordinance
principle_cards.scope: Connects distribution arithmetic to administration/trust handling.
principle_cards.limits: Does not by itself determine who should be administrator or what Registry forms are required.

principle_cards.principle_text: A person attains full age at 18, which matters for minor-beneficiary administration and statutory trust vesting questions.
principle_cards.exact_quote: a person shall attain full age on attaining the age of 18 years
principle_cards.scope: Supports the minor/adult distinction in the probate demo.
principle_cards.limits: Vesting/payment mechanics still require checking Cap. 73 and the administration route.
